name: interactive-xapi-designer
description: Build compact, accessible SLS interactives with verified scoring, meaningful action histories, and targeted misconception feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Build compact SLS interactives with illuminating learning evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turns a learning goal or existing interactive into a compact, accessible SLS-ready package in one pass, with a 450px first-viewport design, verified scoring, chronological action evidence, explained misconceptions, learner next steps, targeted teaching moves, completion fallback capture, and mock-LRS transport checks.
defaultPrompt: Build an SLS interactive that fits the 450px first viewport, with verified scoring, useful learner feedback, and targeted teaching moves.
Turn this lesson idea into an accessible virtual lab with a meaningful, time-ordered record of learner exploration.
Improve this ZIP for SLS with a compact shared workspace, evidence-based misconceptions, and an illuminating learner and teacher report.
